bibleState.role: Protagonist. Pilots the night ferry across a tidal river port.
bibleState.want: To buy the ferry outright before the company sells it for scrap.

bibleState.subject: What the living owe to plans the dead made for them.
bibleState.thematic_question: Is keeping a promise to someone who has died an act of love or an act of surrender?

priorAnswers.question: Which characters feel this question most sharply?

bibleState.opening_disturbance: Her father dies and leaves the family vineyard to a stranger.
complications: Her brother takes the stranger's side.
Blight reaches the lower slopes before harvest.
bibleState.climax: On the night of the auction Nell sets fire to the vines herself.

priorAnswers.question: What does Nell gain by burning the vines she set out to win back?
priorAnswers.answer: I'm not sure yet. It felt right when I outlined it.
